profile.headline: Prominent Apache Lucene/Solr Committer | Co-Creator of SolrCloud | Distributed Search Expert | AI-Assisted Software Developer since GPT3.5 | 5-person startup to the largest company in the world.
profile.summary: I spend a lot of my free time building data curation tools, curating data, training and fine-tuning models, and playing with GenAI.

positions.title: Member
positions.description: The Apache Software Foundation (ASF) is a non-profit corporation (classified as 501(c)(3) in the United States) that supports Apache software projects. Members are shareholders in the corporation.

positions.title: Lucene PMC Member
positions.description: A project management committee (PMC) is a committee of the Apache Software Foundation charged with responsibility for a top level project. The PMC is the vehicle through which decision making power and responsibility for oversight is devolved to developers.
